summary: Iteration 3 re-test after fixes. Both critical iteration_2 bugs are RESOLVED. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_deposits_and_vehicles.py is 5/5 PASS: POST /api/vehicles now persists security_deposit=2500 and walk_around_video; subsequent GET echoes back the same values; deposit GET/POST/mark-paid still pass; assign-after-deposit gate succeeds. Frontend deposit card now renders correctly on /customer/payments: card visible (testID=deposit-card), Pay Deposit button visible when shortfall (testID=pay-deposit-button), tapping it opens the modal (testID=deposit-txn-input + confirm-deposit-button), submitting transaction id TEST123 updates the card to the fully paid state (no Pay Deposit button, sub-text 'Deposit fully paid. Refundable on return.'), and backend deposit balance reflects 2500. Sanity checks still pass: admin Add Vehicle modal shows field-deposit + Walk-around Video Camera/Gallery buttons; customer home location-banner is rendered (web preview).

design_issues.screen: Customer Payments modal (Confirm Deposit Payment sheet)
issues: Confirm Deposit modal's 'Credit Deposit' button can sit just below the visible viewport area on the 375x667 mobile preview, requiring a scroll/scroll-into-view to click. Real users will likely scroll the sheet, but on small screens the CTA could be hidden behind the keyboard. Consider tightening modal padding or making the sheet scrollable so the primary CTA is always visible above the fold.

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple console warnings on every screen: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Sources are third-party components (likely react-native-safe-area-context / Ionicons). Reference: customer/payments.tsx and others (warnings logged when these screens mount).
